items.text: Okhubalzva khwabalsiraeli eMoabu
Ne olunyuma Iwoluumbe, OMWAMI yabeolela Musa nende Eleazari waHaruni omukuhani, ari
Mubale obunji bwabomu khung'aano kwosi kwabaana baIsiraeli, okhurula khubemiyika amakhumi kabili nende abashilaho; mubilibwa biabwe, mbu bosi abakhanyala okhurula okhutsia mwihe muIsiraeli.
Kho Musa naEleazari omukuhani nibasungana ninabo mumuhololookhwe kwaMoabu, ahambi naYorodani, eYeriko; bari
Mubale obunji bwabandu okhurula khubemiyika amakhumi kabili nende abashilaho; shinga OMWAMI olwa yalaka Musa nende abaana baIsiraeli abarula mushibala shiaMisiri.
Abeene mbabano; mbu Reubeni, omwana wambeli waYakobo. Abaana baReubeni; mbu khuHanokhu, inzu yabaHanokhu; khuPalu, inzu yabaPalu;
khuHezeroni, inzu yabaHezeroni; khuKarami, inzu yabaKarami.
Etsio nitsio tsinzu tsiabaReubeni; nababalwa khubo ebikhumila amakhumi kane nabitaru ebikhumi musaafu namakhumi kataru.
Nabaana baPalu, mbu Eliabu.
Nabaana baEliabu, mbu Nemueli, naDatsani, naAbiramu. Abo nibo Datsani naAbiramu tsana, abakofu beshiina, abayingana nende Musa naHaruni mumukanda kwaKora, olwa bayingana nOMWAMI
liloba niliasama omunwa nilibamila bukala, halala naKora, olwa abomukanda okwo bafwa; olwa omulilo kwahulula abandu ebikhumi bibili namakhumi karaano, nibeekhola eshilolelo.
Nebutswa abaana baKora Shibafwa ta.
Abaana baSimeoni munzu tsiabwe; mbu khuNemueli, inzu yabaNemueli; khuYamini, inzu yabaYamini; khuYakhini, inzu yabaYakhini;
khuZera, inzu yabaZera; khuShauli, inzu yabaShauli.
Etsio nitsio tsinzu tsiabaSimeoni, mbu ebikhumila amakhumi kabili nebibili nebikhumi bibili.
Abaana baGadi munzu tsiabwe; mbu khuZefoni, inzu yabaZefoni; khuHagi, inzu yabaHagi; khuShuni, inzu yabaShuni;
khuOzini, inzu yabaOzini; khuEri, inzu yabaEri;
khuArodi, inzu yabaArodi; khuAreli, inzu yabaAreli.
Etsio nitsio tsinzu tsiabaana baGadi, ababalwa khubo shinga olwa bali, mbu ebikhumila amakhumi kane nebikhumi biraano.
Abaana baYuda, mbu Eri naOnani; ne Eri naOnani bafwila mushialo shiaKanaani.
Nabaana baYuda munzu tsiabwe mbabano; mbu khuShela, inzu yabaShela; khuPerezi, inzu yabaPerezi; khuZera, inzu yabaZera.
Nabaana baPerezi mbabano; mbu khuHezeroni, inzu yabaHezeroni; khuHamuli, inzu yabaHamuli.
Etsio nitsio tsinzu tsiaYuda, ababalwa khubo shinga olwa bali, mbu ebikhumila amakhumi musaafu nabisasaba nebikhumi biraano.
Abaana baIsakhari munzu tsiabwe; mbu khuTola, inzu yabaTola; khuPuwa, inzu yaba Puwa;
khuYashubu, inzu yabaYashubu; khuShimironi, inzu yabaShimironi.
Etsio nitsio tsinzu tsiaIsakhari, ababalwa khubo shinga olwa bali, mbu ebikhumila amakhumi kasasaba nahine nebikhumi bitaru.
Abaana baZabuloni munzu tsiabwe; mbu kkuSeredi, inzu yabaSeredi; khuEloni, inzu yabaEloni; khuYaleeli, inzu yabaYaleeli.
Etsio nitsio tsinzu tsiaZabuloni, ababalwa khubo shinga olwa bali, mbu ebikhumila amakhumi kasasaba nebikhumi biraano.
Abaana baYusufu munzu tsiabwe, mbu Manase naEfuraimu.
Abaana baManase; mbu khuMakhiri, inzu yabaMakhiri; naye Makhiri yeebula Gileadi; khuGileadi, inzu yabaGileadi.
Abaana baGileadi mbabano; mbu khuIezeri, inzu yabaIezeri; khuHeleki, inzu yabaHeleki;
khuAsirieli, inzu yabaAsirieli; khuShekhemu, inzu yabaShekhemu;
khuShemida, inzu yabaShemida; khuHeferi, inzu yabaHeferi.
Ne Zelofehadi waHeferi shiyali nomwana omusiani yesi ta, habula abakhaana; ne ameera kabakhaana baZelofehadi ngakano, mbu Mala, naNoa, naHogila, naMilika, naTiriza.
Etsio nitsio tsinzu tsiaManase; nabo ababalwa khubo bali ebikhumila amakhuni karaano nabibili nehikhumi musaafu.
Abaana baEfuriamu mbabano, munzu tsiabwe; mbu khuShutsela, inzu yabaShutsela; khuBekheri, inzu yabaEekheri; khuTahani, inzu yabaTahani.
Khandi abaana baShutsela mbabano, mbu khuErani, inzu yabaErani.
Etsio nitsio tsinzu tsiabaana ba Efuraimu ababalwa khubo shinga olwa bali, mbu ebikhumila amakhumi kataru nabibili nebikhumi biraano. Abo nibo abaana baYusufu munzu tsiabwe.
Abaana baBenyamini munzu tsiabwe; mbu khuBela, inzu yabaBela; khuAshibeli, inzu yabaAshibeli; khuAhiramu, inzu yabaAhiramu;
khuShefufamu, inzu yabaShefufamu; khuHufamu, inzu yabaHufamu.
Nabaana baBela mbabano, mbu Aridi naNaamani; khuAridi, inzu yabaAridi; khuNaamani, inzu yabaNaamani.
Abo nibo abaana baBenyamini munzu tsiabwe; nabo ababalwa khubo bali ebikhumila amakhumi kane nabiraano nebikhumi bisasaba.
Abaana baDani mbabano, munzu tsiabwe; mbu khuShuhamu, inzu yabaShuhamu. Etsio nitsio tsinzu tsiaDani munzu tsiabwe.
Tsinzu tsiosi tsiabaShuhamu, ababalwa khubo shinga olwa bali, bali ebikhumila amakhumi kasasaba nabine nebikhumi bine.
Abaana baAsheri munzu tsiabwe; mbu khuImina, inzu yabaImina; khuIshiwi, inzu yabaIshiwi; khuBeria, inzu yabaBeria.
Khubaana baBeria; mbu khuHeberi, inzu yabaHeberi; khuMalakieli, inzu yabaMalakieli.
Ne eliira liomukhaana waAsheri liali Sera.
Etsio nitsio tsinzu tsiabaana baAsheri, ababalwa khubo shinga olwa bali, mbu ebikhumila amakhumi karaano nabitaru nebikhumi bine.
Abaana baNafutali munzu tsiabwe; mbu khuYazeeli, inzu yabaYazeeli; khuGuni, inzu yabaGuni;
khuYezeri, inzu yabaYezeri; khuShilemu, inzu yabaShilemu.
Etsio nitsio tsinzu tsiaNafutali, tsinzu tsiabwe shinga olwa tsiali; nabo ababalwa khubo bali ebikhumila amakhumi kane nabiraano nebikhumi bine.
Abo nibo ababalu a khubaana baIsiraeli, mbu ebikhumila ebikhumi bisasaba nashilala nebikhumi musaafu namakhumi kataru.
Eshialo okhukabulua nishikkupiiua ikha
Mana OMWAMI naboolela Musa ari
Eshialo shilakabulilwa abo shibe obulaame, obunji bwameera shinga okva buli.
Khubali abanji, obaheelesie obulaame obuli obunji; ne khubali abatuutu, obaheelesie obulaame obuli obutuutu; buli mundu aheebwe obulaamebwe, obunji bwabandube ababalwa shinga olwa buli.
Nebutswa eshialo shikabulwe nishikhupilwa ikha; ameera ketsimbia tsiabakuuka babwe shinga olwa tsili, nolwa balalaamilwa.
Ikha shinga olwa yilaba, nolwa obulaame bwabwe bulakabulilwa, khubali abanji nokhubali abatuutu.
Oluyia lwabaLawi
Ababalwa khubaLawi munzu tsiabwe mbabano; mbu khuGerishoni, inzu yabaGerishoni; khuKokatsi, inzu yabaKohatsi; khuMerari, inzu yabaMerari.
Tsinzu tsiaLawi nzietsino; mbu inzu yabaLibini, inzu yabaHeberoni, inzu yabaMali, inzu yabaMushi, inzu yabaKora. Naye Kohatsi niyeebula Amuramu.
Neliira liomukhasi waAmuramu liali Yokebedi, omukhaana waLawi, owa Lawi yeebulila eMisiri; naye naAmuramu nibeebula Haruni naMusa, naMiriamu omukhaana wabwe.
Naye Haruni niyeebula Nadabu naAbihu, Eleazari naItsamari.
Nabo Nadabu naAbihu nibafwa olwa bahaana omulilo okwalukano imbeli wOMWAMI.

Nabo ababalwa khubo bali ebikhumila amakhumi kabili nabitaru, mbu abeshisaatsa bosi okhurula khubomwesi mulala nende abashilaho. Okhuba shibabalilwa mubaana baIsiraeli, shichila shibwaliho obulaame bwosi obwa baheebwa mubaana baisiraeli tawe.
Kalebu naYoswa nibo bonyene abasikala
Abo nibo ababalwa nende Musa naEleazari omukuhani, ababala abaana baIsiraeli mumuho-lolookhwe kwaMoabu, ahambi naYorodani eYeriko.
Nebutswa shiyalikhwo khubo omundu yesi owali niyabalwa nende Musa naHaruni omukuhani, olwa babala abaana baIsiraeli mushitsiimi shieSinai, ta.
Okhuba OMWAMI yali niyasunga khubo ari Okhufwa balafwila mushitsiimi. Ne shiyatong'akhwo khubo omundu yesi ta, habula Kalebu waYefune naYoswa waNuni.
